name: lti
label: IMS Global LTI (Learning Tools)
description: Learning Tools Interoperability — standard for connecting LMS to external learning tools

table_notes.lti_platform: Represents an LMS (e.g. Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard) registered as an LTI 1.3 platform, storing its OIDC and JWKS endpoints for secure launch verification.
table_notes.lti_tool: Describes an external learning tool (the 'TP' side) including its launch URL, supported placements, and privacy level for data sharing with the platform.
table_notes.lti_deployment: Join between a platform and a tool capturing the IMS deployment_id and course context; one tool can be deployed multiple times within the same platform.
table_notes.lti_launch: Immutable audit record of each tool launch, capturing the authenticated user, IMS roles, resource link context, and anti-replay nonce.

lti_platform.name: id
lti_platform.description: Surrogate primary key for this platform registration

lti_platform.name: name
lti_platform.description: Human-readable label for the LMS (e.g. 'Canvas Production', 'Moodle Dev')

lti_platform.name: client_id
lti_platform.description: OAuth 2.0 client_id issued by the platform during LTI tool registration

lti_platform.name: issuer
lti_platform.description: OIDC issuer URL that uniquely identifies the platform (e.g. https://canvas.instructure.com)

lti_platform.name: auth_endpoint
lti_platform.description: Platform OIDC authentication endpoint used to initiate the login flow

lti_platform.name: token_endpoint
lti_platform.description: Platform OAuth 2.0 token endpoint for obtaining access tokens (LTI Advantage services)

lti_platform.name: jwks_url
lti_platform.description: Platform JWKS URL for fetching public keys to verify ID token signatures

lti_platform.name: public_key
lti_platform.description: Cached PEM-encoded public key from the platform (fallback if JWKS is unavailable)

lti_platform.name: is_active
lti_platform.description: Whether this platform registration is currently accepting launches

lti_tool.name: id
lti_tool.description: Surrogate primary key for this tool definition

lti_tool.name: name
lti_tool.description: Display name of the external tool shown to instructors and students

lti_tool.name: description
lti_tool.description: Long-form description of the tool's purpose for catalog or admin display

lti_tool.name: launch_url
lti_tool.description: Default target URL the platform redirects to after OIDC login (the tool's entry point)

lti_tool.name: deep_link_url
lti_tool.description: URL for LTI Deep Linking (Content-Item) requests to select embedded resources

lti_tool.name: icon_url
lti_tool.description: URL of the tool icon shown in the LMS course navigation or activity picker

lti_tool.name: custom_params
lti_tool.description: Key-value map of custom LTI parameters sent to the tool on every launch (e.g. {"canvas_course_id":"$Canvas.course.id"})

lti_deployment.name: id
lti_deployment.description: Surrogate primary key for this deployment record

lti_deployment.name: platform_id
lti_deployment.description: Reference to the LMS platform (lti_platform) where the tool is deployed

lti_deployment.name: tool_id
lti_deployment.description: Reference to the tool definition (lti_tool) being deployed

lti_deployment.name: deployment_id
lti_deployment.description: IMS-assigned deployment_id claim from the platform; scopes the tool within the LMS installation

lti_deployment.name: context_id
lti_deployment.description: LTI context_id claim identifying the course or group within the platform

lti_deployment.name: context_title
lti_deployment.description: Human-readable course or context title sent by the platform at registration time

lti_deployment.name: is_active
lti_deployment.description: Whether this deployment is currently enabled for new launches

lti_launch.name: id
lti_launch.description: Surrogate primary key for this launch event record

lti_launch.name: deployment_id
lti_launch.description: Reference to the deployment (lti_deployment) that produced this launch

lti_launch.name: user_id
lti_launch.description: Platform-issued opaque user identifier from the LTI 'sub' claim; stable per user per platform

lti_launch.name: user_name
lti_launch.description: Display name of the launching user as provided by the platform (may be null if anonymous)

lti_launch.name: roles
lti_launch.description: Array of IMS LTI role URIs (e.g. ["http://purl.imsglobal.org/vocab/lis/v2/membership#Instructor"])

lti_launch.name: resource_link_id
lti_launch.description: Stable identifier for the specific link/activity in the LMS that triggered this launch

lti_launch.name: resource_link_title
lti_launch.description: Human-readable title of the LMS activity or assignment that launched the tool

lti_launch.name: custom_params
lti_launch.description: Key-value map of custom parameters resolved at launch time (variable substitutions expanded by the platform)

lti_launch.name: launched_at
lti_launch.description: Timestamp when the launch was initiated (UTC, server-set)

lti_launch.name: nonce
lti_launch.description: One-time value from the OIDC ID token used to prevent replay attacks; should be consumed on first use

short_description: Learning Tools Interoperability — standard for connecting LMS to external learning tools
long_description: IMS Global LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) 1.3 enables secure, standards-based integration between LMS platforms and external learning tools. The schema models platforms (Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard), tools (external apps), deployments (tool registration in an LMS context), and individual launch records with user roles and context.
when_to_use: Use for building edtech tools that integrate with university LMS systems. LTI 1.3 is required for integration with Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, and D2L Brightspace. Essential for gradebook passback (LTI Advantage Assignments and Grades Service). Required by most university instructional technology procurement policies.
